data.summary: Zahnarztpraxis Beispielweiß reminds Bastian Musterquell of his professional teeth cleaning appointment on Monday, 14 December 2026 at 16:15, lasting about one hour. If he cannot attend, he should cancel at least two working days in advance.
data.explanation: This is a routine appointment reminder from your dentist, not an urgent letter. Your next professional teeth cleaning is scheduled for 14 December 2026 at 16:15 and takes about an hour. If something comes up and you cannot make it, call or email the practice at least two working days beforehand so they can offer the slot to someone else. No payment is requested in this letter, and no action is needed unless you need to cancel.
